lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: #ifndef VD_NET_HTTP_H

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: #define VD_NET_HTTP_H

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: #include <stdbool.h>

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: #include <stddef.h>

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: #include "arena.h"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: #define VD_HTTP_HEADER_MAX 32768

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Copies the trimmed value of the header line starting with `name:` (case-insensitive). False if absent or too long.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: bool http_header_value(const char *headers, const char *name, char *out, size_t out_size);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Returns -1 when Content-Length is missing or not a decimal number.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: long http_content_length(const char *headers);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Compares the Content-Type media type, ignoring parameters and case.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: bool http_content_type_is(const char *headers, const char *media_type);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: unsigned char *http_find_bytes(unsigned char *haystack, size_t haystack_len, const char *needle);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Reads the headers and a Content-Length body of at most max_body bytes into the arena. The body is NUL-terminated

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // one byte past its length. On failure *error_status is 413 when the body is too large, else 400.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: bool http_read_request(Arena *arena, int fd, size_t max_body, char **out_headers, unsigned char **out_body,

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: size_t *out_body_len, int *error_status);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: void http_send_response(int fd, int status, const char *status_text, const char *content_type, const char *body);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Reads past the request headers first, for a reply that does not need the request.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: void http_send_simple_response(int fd, int status, const char *status_text, const char *content_type, const char *body);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Sends the `{"ok":false,"code","message"}` body Runtime Upload and Host Control share.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: void http_send_json_error(int fd, int status, const char *code, const char *message);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Lingering close after an early rejection: a client still sending its body would otherwise get a connection reset

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // instead of the reply. Reads at most max_body plus the headers, giving up after a quiet timeout.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: void http_drain_rejected_request(int fd, size_t max_body);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: #endif /* VD_NET_HTTP_H */
